title: The Web Awakens
narrative: 1991 was the year the World Wide Web stepped out of CERN's shadows and into the world. Tim Berners-Lee posted his quiet announcement on Usenet, Linus Torvalds released Linux, and a camera at Cambridge invented the webcam.
